stem: A 2-year-old boy presents to the emergency department with sudden coughing after a choking episode while playing with Lego. Decubitus chest X-rays were obtained: Image 1 with the right side down and Image 2 with the left side down. What is the important finding in the two chest X-rays shown?

options.text: Compression of the left lung is more obvious in the left side down decubitus view
The right lung field remained hyper inflated in both positions
The left lung field appeared more compressed with the right side down
The hyperinflation is more obvious in the Left side down decubitus view

explanation: In suspected foreign body aspiration, decubitus films help identify air trapping. The abnormal side is the one that remains relatively overexpanded and does not compress normally with the dependent position. Here, the left lung appears more compressed when the right side is down, indicating asymmetric air trapping/compression consistent with a left-sided obstructive process.

citations.title: Practice Quiz: Chest X-Ray - Part B

rationale: The best answer is the option describing left lung compression on the right-side-down decubitus view, which is the key asymmetric finding.

optionExplanations.A: This describes the opposite pattern and is not the key finding.
optionExplanations.B: This is too nonspecific and does not identify the asymmetric finding between views.
optionExplanations.C: Correct: the left lung appears more compressed when the right side is down.
optionExplanations.D: This reverses the expected relationship between dependent position and hyperinflation.
